description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'CreditReportNotFoundException' extending a base exception class for resource not found errors. It is used for handling cases where a credit report with a specific identifier is not found in the system.
external_methods: super(String messageCode, String defaultMessage, Object... args)

classes.name: CreditReportNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom exception class indicating that a credit report with a specific identifier could not be found.

methods.name: CreditReportNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific credit report ID, generating an appropriate error message.

calls: super("error.msg.creditreport.identifier.not.found", "CreditReport with identifier `" + searchId + "` does not exist", searchId)
